metadata.title: Late 80s Pop Portrait with Angled Tape Overlays

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, tight-cropped facial portrait featuring dark hair and bold lips, overlaid with diagonal grey tape-like strips containing script typography.
excludeWhen: sans-serif typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, extreme close-up of a face with a dark bob and bangs, characterized by high-key lighting on the skin and deep shadows in the hair, framed by diagonal grey banners with handwritten-style text at the top and bottom corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hair frames the pale face to create a strong oval focal point.
Diagonal text strips at the top-left and bottom-right create a dynamic counter-balance.
The vibrant red lips serve as a secondary color anchor against the neutral skin and hair.
The warm yellow-orange glow at the bottom edges provides a soft environmental contrast to the dark hair.
coreInvariants: Tight facial crop cutting off the top of the head and shoulders.
High contrast between dark hair/eyes and pale skin.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and fills approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and red lips form a central vertical axis of interest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text strip, moves down through the eyes to the lips, and exits through the bottom-right text strips.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily found in the small yellow-orange gradients at the lower corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale cream/white for skin tones and deep black for hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Medium grey for the text overlay strips.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bold crimson red for the lips and primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face; low saturation overall except for the lips and the warm yellow glow.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted greys, blacks, and warm skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes mimicking marker or brush pen
Variable line weight with visible pressure changes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' bars are long and sweeping

composition.overlap: on top of hair and chin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a large, bold red script with a smaller, thinner white script on separate banners.
graphicDevices: Rough-edged grey rectangular strips resembling torn tape
Diagonal orientation for all text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-drawn, informal feel of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary fluid connections and variable stroke width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast close-up portrait of a woman with a dark bob haircut and bangs, pale skin, and bright red lipstick. Use soft yellow lighting at the bottom corners and a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three diagonal grey rectangular strips: one at the top left and two staggered at the bottom right. Place custom cursive script text inside these strips, using red for the top and white for the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the face tightly cropped with the hair framing the features?
Are the text banners angled diagonally?
Is the typography a fluid script rather than a standard font?
Is there a strong contrast between the pale skin and dark hair?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the eyes or mouth.
Check that the grey strips have slightly irregular, non-perfect edges.
Verify the script is legible despite the diagonal angle.
Confirm the hair texture appears dense and dark.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait [Subject] + [Hair Style] + High Contrast Lighting + Diagonal [Color] Tape Overlays + [Color] Script Typography
